explanation: This environment does not accept `put`, `place`, `drop`, `insert`, `set`, `store`, `hang` or `throw`: every such command returns "Nothing happens." The accepted placement command is `move <object> to <receptacle>`, for example `move mug 1 to cabinet 1`, issued while holding the object and standing at the receptacle.

evidence.corroboration: plain baseline final messages: 'move ... to' in 3/15 successes and 0/125 failures; 'in/on' only in failures
evidence.note: Harbor's ALFWorld instruction template tells the agent to use `put <object> in/on <receptacle>`, which this build rejects.
